turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
And how was that for you?
My wife Meera does not know about the losses, I moved money out of our savings account.
Mm-hm. Go on.
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Take your time.
I have been betting on football online for three years and last month I lost eleven thousand pounds.
And how was that for you?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. It is not easy to talk about.
Tell me more about that.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
And how was that for you?
Sometimes I think everyone would be better off without me, but I would never do anything.
How did that feel for you?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. That is how it was.
And how was that for you?
I work as an accountant at a small firm in Leicester, so I know exactly how bad the numbers are.
How did that feel for you?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. That is how it was.
Let us stop here for today.
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
